release_notes.zh-CN: 修复：开启时界面文字未显示、设置面板无法打开、记录面板无法打开、顶部工具列按钮无法点击、设置与记录按钮事件失效。改善：顶部工具列按钮加上文字标签。
release_notes.en: Fixed: interface text not showing on launch, Settings panel not opening, History panel not opening, top toolbar buttons not clickable, and Settings/History button handlers not firing. Improved: top toolbar buttons now carry text labels.
